description: The nth look-and-say term, starting from 1. Term 1 is 1, term 4 is 1211, and term 5 is 111221. Each run of k copies of a digit d becomes the digits of k followed by d. n runs from 1 to 25. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say
